svg.title: Global Shipbuilding Capacity: China vs. the U.S.
svg.desc: This chart compares annual shipbuilding capacity between major nations. The United States has a relatively small capacity, represented by a single ship, while China’s shipbuilding power is exponentially larger, producing over 300 times more ships. The visualization highlights China’s dominant position in the global shipbuilding industry, underscoring the scale of its maritime manufacturing capabilities compared to the U.S.
